---
title: "BEC Labels"
format:
  html:
    theme: journal
params:
  plot_number: ""
  plot_numbers: ""
  site_unit: ""
  project_id: ""
  db_path: "../data/vpro.duckdb"
  parquet_dir: ""
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(duckdb)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

options(knitr.table.format = "html")
root_candidates <- c(
  Sys.getenv("QUARTO_PROJECT_DIR", unset = ""),
  getwd(),
  file.path(getwd(), ".."),
  file.path(getwd(), "../..")
)
root_candidates <- unique(root_candidates[nzchar(root_candidates)])
root_dir <- NA_character_
for (candidate in root_candidates) {
  candidate <- normalizePath(candidate, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  if (file.exists(file.path(candidate, "R", "logic_reports_veg.R"))) {
    root_dir <- candidate
    break
  }
}
if (is.na(root_dir)) stop("Unable to locate project root for report helpers.")
source(file.path(root_dir, "R", "logic_reports_veg.R"))
parquet_dir <- params$parquet_dir
if (!is.null(parquet_dir) && nzchar(trimws(parquet_dir))) {
  con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), dbdir = ":memory:")
  tbls <- c("Sample_Env", "Sample_SU")
  for (tbl in tbls) {
    file_name <- paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", tbl), ".parquet")
    file_path <- file.path(parquet_dir, file_name)
    if (file.exists(file_path)) {
      dbExecute(
        con,
        sprintf("CREATE TABLE %s AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet('%s')", tbl, gsub("'", "''", file_path))
      )
    }
  }
} else {
  con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), params$db_path, read_only = TRUE)
}
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
plots <- parse_plot_numbers(params$plot_number, params$plot_numbers)
if (length(plots) == 0 && nzchar(trimws(params$site_unit)) && DBI::dbExistsTable(con, "Sample_SU")) {
  su_df <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
    con,
    "SELECT PlotNumber FROM Sample_SU WHERE SiteUnit = ?",
    list(trimws(params$site_unit))
  )
  plots <- unique(as.character(su_df$PlotNumber))
}
if (length(plots) == 0 && nzchar(trimws(params$project_id)) && DBI::dbExistsTable(con, "Sample_Env")) {
  env_df <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
    con,
    "SELECT PlotNumber FROM Sample_Env WHERE ProjectID = ?",
    list(trimws(params$project_id))
  )
  plots <- unique(as.character(env_df$PlotNumber))
}

plots <- plots[nzchar(plots)]
if (length(plots) > 0) {
  plot_sql <- paste(DBI::dbQuoteString(con, plots), collapse = ", ")
  labels <- dbGetQuery(
    con,
    sprintf(
      "SELECT plotnumber, projectid, zone, subzone FROM Sample_Env WHERE PlotNumber IN (%s) ORDER BY plotnumber",
      plot_sql
    )
  )
} else if (nzchar(trimws(params$project_id))) {
  labels <- dbGetQuery(
    con,
    "SELECT plotnumber, projectid, zone, subzone FROM Sample_Env WHERE ProjectID = ? ORDER BY plotnumber",
    list(trimws(params$project_id))
  )
} else {
  labels <- dbGetQuery(
    con,
    "SELECT plotnumber, projectid, zone, subzone FROM Sample_Env ORDER BY plotnumber"
  )
}

normalize_env_cols <- function(df) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(df)
  cols <- names(df)
  pick_col <- function(candidates) {
    idx <- which(tolower(cols) %in% tolower(candidates))
    if (length(idx) > 0) cols[[idx[1]]] else NA_character_
  }
  plot_col <- pick_col(c("plotnumber", "PlotNumber"))
  proj_col <- pick_col(c("projectid", "ProjectID"))
  zone_col <- pick_col(c("zone", "Zone"))
  subzone_col <- pick_col(c("subzone", "SubZone"))
  if (!is.na(plot_col)) df$plotnumber <- df[[plot_col]]
  if (!is.na(proj_col)) df$projectid <- df[[proj_col]]
  if (!is.na(zone_col)) df$zone <- df[[zone_col]]
  if (!is.na(subzone_col)) df$subzone <- df[[subzone_col]]
  df
}

labels <- normalize_env_cols(labels)

dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
```

# BEC Labels

```{r labels-table, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (nrow(labels) > 0) {
  kbl(labels, align = "l") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("No labels available.")
}
```
